recalled_knowledge.item: Standard Halo Model parameters v0=238, v_esc=544 km/s, v_sun,pec=(11.1,12.2,7.3) km/s, rho0=0.3 GeV/cm3 (Baxter et al. 2021), used via lzcommon
Inelastic scattering kinematics: v_min = (m_N E/mu + delta)/sqrt(2 m_N E); E_+- formula; delta_abs = mu v^2/2
Natural xenon isotopic abundances and A*amu masses (via lzcommon)
The dips at ~100 and ~265 keV in the O1 xenon spectrum are zeros of the M (SI) nuclear form factor and are independent of m_chi and delta
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Helm/shell-model form factor literature (Lewin & Smith 1996; Anand et al. 2014)

recalled_knowledge.item: Earth orbital speed projection ~15 km/s with peak on ~2 June (via lzcommon.v_earth_kms)
